title: Practice 5: By means of: the instrument

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Шмультке стукнул ___ (дуло) парабеллума о стол, — Имя, фамилия?
exercises.why: Instrumental without с is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. The word in the instrumental case will correspond to English "by means of…", "by the use of…": *Он открывает дверь ключом. Я пишу карандашом. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  «The Instrumental without С is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted.» — DLI, Lesson 30.
exercises.context: Instrumental without с is used when an instrument or agent of the action is denoted. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30)
